name: gaffer_save
description: Save the open script; with path, save it under that .gfr (as the open file, or a copy with copy true: the open script keeps its name). Relative paths are next to the current file; an existing other file needs overwrite. Says what was written, read from the disk (path, bytes, time), the open file afterwards and whether unsaved changes remain. gaffer_verify with saved reads the file back.
